answer: We deploy a Sybil-resistant mechanism using staking collateral and zero-knowledge verifiable delay, projecting identities via a cryptographic prism to enforce subgame-perfect slashing penalties. This capital barrier forces any isolated sparrow exploiting the network inlet for identity multiplication to face exponential collateral demands, proving the expected attack utility is strictly negative. Thus, the system converges to a robust Nash equilibrium where rational adversaries reject Sybil replication, securing consensus against multi-agent manipulation.
